paragraphs: Gamliel Zuga questioned Rabbi Yose, son of Rabbi Bun: Jerusalem Talmud, end of Shekalim chapter 3. In the Gemara there: Gamalyon Zuvta. He questioned Rabbi Abba bar Zavda: Jerusalem Talmud, Nedarim chapter 8, halakhah 5. It seems to me to be a scribal error, because Rabbi Abba bar Zavda was a student of Rav Huna, and this Gamliel preceded him. After searching, I found that matter in Demai chapter 2, end of halakhah 1: he questioned Rabbi Abba bar Kahana, and this pleased me. His sister died; Hillel his brother went up with him. Rabbi Mana said to him: Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Ellu Megallechin, halakhah 5. Rabbi Yochanan questioned him: Orlah, beginning of chapter 2. He went up to the house of Rabbi Yannai: Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Keitzad Mevarkhin, mishnah 4. Sh.Y. writes there: this is what he calls him in Megillah chapter 1, and it is like Zuta. He questioned Rabbi Yisa: Terumot chapter 11, halakhah 7. He was leaning on Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi: Jerusalem Talmud, Avodah Zarah chapter 3, halakhah 13. He questioned Rabbi Mana: there, end of Beitzah. In the name of Rav Shmuel, Rabbi Berekhiah’s brother: Orlah, beginning of chapter 2. He made a sukkah in the marketplace; Resh Lakish said to him, “Who permitted you?” There, beginning of chapter Lulav HaGazul.
